content.text: Return only one JSON object with integer fields n_features, n_significant, n_up, n_down, n_na_padj. No explanation.

Count all rows. Significant means padj < 0.050000000000000003 AND abs(log2FoldChange) > 1. NA padj is not significant. Up/down means positive/negative significant log2FoldChange. n_na_padj counts NA padj.
CSV table:
"feature_id","log2FoldChange","padj"
"warm_a",2,0.001
"warm_b",-0.1,NA
